# LinkSight

> Precision RF link planning and Fresnel zone clearance calculations on Android mobile devices. Built for field engineers, WISP operators, Meshtastic/LoRa networks, and drone pilots.

## Overview
LinkSight is a native Android mobile application designed for instant point-to-point microwave link planning and line-of-sight (LOS) analysis directly in the field. It uses global SRTM90m topography data to calculate terrain elevation profiles and Fresnel zone obstructions with sub-second latency.

## Key Features
- **Line of Sight (LOS) Analysis**: Instant terrain elevation profile calculations between two GPS coordinates using SRTM90m global data.
- **Fresnel Zone Clearance**: Real-time Fresnel zone calculation and obstruction detection across standard frequencies (2.4 GHz, 5.8 GHz, Sub-GHz 868 MHz) and custom frequencies.
- **Interactive Map & Mast Height Tuning**: Interactive GPS coordinate pin-dropping with dynamic antenna mast height adjustments.
- **Professional PDF Reports**: One-tap export of comprehensive RF feasibility study reports with elevation charts, link budgets, and technical metrics.
- **Cloud Topography**: Millisecond profile downloads without requiring gigabytes of offline maps.

## Target Users & Use Cases
- **WISP Operators**: Plan broadband point-to-point microwave links and verify tower heights before dispatching installation crews.
- **Meshtastic & LoRa Networks**: Design off-grid mesh networks and ensure sub-GHz signal path through complex terrain.
- **UAV & Drone Pilots (BVLOS)**: Verify telemetry and video link line-of-sight across terrain obstacles.
- **RF & Telecom Engineers**: Custom frequency and mast height calculations for amateur radio, public safety, and proprietary wireless networks.

## Technical Specifications
- **Platform**: Android Native (Kotlin)
- **Elevation Data**: SRTM90m (Shuttle Radar Topography Mission, 90-meter global resolution)
- **Calculation Latency**: <250ms
- **Pricing**: Free tier (5 calculations/day, no credit card required) & Pro tier (unlimited calculations, PDF exports, priority support).
